jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support simulation and modeling capabilities around the innovative DeckFinder product, the global standard for Automatic Take-off and Landing (ATOL) solutions, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for anIntern within Simulation and Modeling (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Simulation Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in optimizing our simulation environment as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen- Start: February 2027- Duration: 6 months- Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. jobs.occupation: HPC Systems Engineer – Machine Learning Infrastructure & Operations (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: ML CloudThe Cluster of Excellence "Machine Learning - New Perspectives for Science" at the Universityof Tübingen offers a position asHPC Systems Engineer – Machine Learning Infrastructure & Operations(m/f/d, E13 TV-L, 100%)The position is available in the team of the Machine Learning Science Cloud and is permanent.About UsThe ML Cloud team designs, runs and safeguards high-performance computing infrastructuretailored to machine learning workloads. Our state of the art systems are distributed across fourdata centers and are operated for the Tübingen AI Center, the Cluster of Excellence ’MachineLearning: New Perspectives for Science’ and the Hertie Institute for AI in Brain Health. Everyday, researchers unleash thousands of compute jobs on our systems, training frontier-scaleneural networks and running experiments.The OpportunityOur clusters keep growing – more GPUs, more storage, and more services around them. Weare looking for an HPC Systems Eingineer who enjoys developing and running productioninfrastructure end to end: from bare-metal compute and the Slurm scheduler to the virtualizationlayer on which central service run, the storage backends and the automation that holds it alltogether. You will keep our systems fast and reliable, extend them as demand grows, and turnmanual work into reproducible, code-driven operations that the whole team can rely on. Youwill be joining a motivated team of HPC specialists who share responsibility for the wholestack, work closely, and have real room to shape how our infrastructure is built and run. Youwill also have the opportunity to shape two new directions: AI agents in our administrativeworkflows, and agent-native access to the clusters for our users.Your Tasks• Design and operate HPC clusters across four data centers – spanning inter-/intra-sitenetworks, SLURM scheduling, parallel filesystems (e.g., Lustre/Ceph), and GPUaccelerators – ensuring high availability and sustained throughput for researchworkloads.• Build and manage provisioning and configuration of heterogeneous compute, storageand network nodes (e.g. image-based provisioning, node lifecycle, Layer 2 and Layer 3networking)ML Cloud• Run and extend our Proxmox virtualization clusters hosting the management plane andinfrastructure services (HA, live migration, backup)• Operate and scale our storage platforms: Ceph clusters for S3-compatible object storagefor research data, including capacity planning, tiering, replication and backup• Automate operations as code with Ansible and Git-based workflows – provisioning,configuration, roll-outs and recurring maintenance• Build and operate monitoring, logging and alerting, and keep systems patched, hardenedand reliable through regular maintenance windows• Plan and carry out hardware roll-outs, capacity extensions and migrations together withvendors and data center staff• Bring AI agents into our admin workflows and build agent-native access to the clusterfor users.• Support and advise users on efficient cluster usage (job scheduling, data handling,storage layout, access workflows)Your Profile• Masters degree in Computer Science or a related field• Solid Linux administration experience in a production environment(RHEL/Rocky/Ubuntu)• Hands-on HPC experience: Slurm, parallel file systems (Weka, Lustre, Ceph), GPUworkloads (driver/CUDA, DCGM, Fabric Manager, NVLink/NVSwitch, MIG) andhigh-speed networks (InfiniBand, 400G Ethernet)• Solid data-center networking skills: Ethernet/IP (VLANs, routing, bonding/LACP),InfiniBand fabric management (subnet manager, fabric diagnostics), and firewall/VPNconfiguration• Experience operating Ceph and S3-compatible object storage (e.g. RADOS Gateway)at scale• Experience with virtualization for the management plane and infrastructure services(Proxmox, including clustering and backup)• Strong automation skills with Ansible (roles, inventories, CI-driven roll-outs) andscripting in Bash and Python• containers (Apptainer/Singularity/Docker), monitoring stacks (Prometheus/Grafana), ordatabase and service operations• A plus: Hands-on LLM tooling (tool calling and APIs, agent frameworks, retrieval andevaluation)• Independent, structured working style and good communication in English; German isa plus• A collaborative, user-facing mindset – comfortable supporting and advising researchersML CloudWhat We Offer• Technically deep, architecturally open work that directly enables cutting-edge machinelearningresearch• A small, senior team with flat hierarchy• Flexible working hours and the option to work partially from home• Working in an English-speaking, international team of HPC experts• Professional development, conference attendance and real influence on our roadmapInterested? We'd love to hear from you!Disabled candidates will be given preference over other equally qualified applicants. TheUniversity of Tübingen is committed to equal opportunities and diversity and actively promotesgender equality. The position is divisible.Please submit your application, including CV and relevant transcripts by December 6, 2026 viaour application portal careers.tuebingen.ai. For questions, please contact Simon Kreuzer atsimon.kreuzer@uni-tuebingen.de. The position is available from now on. Hiring is done by theCentral Administration of the University of Tübingen.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Machine Learning

RoleHive Robotics builds RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms: connecting, controlling and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our systems are made in Germany, in serial production and deployed on active frontlines.You’ll be our first sales hire. There is no sales team, no SDRs and no playbook to inherit. This is a hands-on role: you find the leads, make the calls, write the offers and negotiate the contracts yourself. You work directly with our founders, report to the CEO, and get a lot of trust and room to decide how you sell. We measure you on signed contracts.Some leads come from our founders and Business Development. Many you’ll find yourself, through cold calls, cold emails, events and your own network. You take over a live pipeline and our existing customers, so we expect your first closes within three months.You don’t need a defence background or an engineering degree. Our engineers and Field Application Engineers know the product in depth, and you can bring them in whenever a deal needs it. What we need from you is the ability to run large, complex deals to signature on your own.Responsibilities- Close deals. Take opportunities from the first conversation to a signed contract, negotiate price and terms yourself, and bring in the founders when a deal needs them.- Build your own pipeline. Leads from the founders and BD give you a start. The rest comes from your own outreach: cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, trade fairs and introductions you find yourself.- Grow our existing customers through follow-on orders, new units and new use cases.- Write the offer: configuration and pricing, terms, the business case on the customer’s own numbers and the plan to signature. Handle tenders and RFPs where they apply.- Use trials to win contracts. Before a trial starts, scope, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract are agreed in writing. Operations handles the paperwork.- Keep a forecast the founders can plan with: disciplined qualification, an up-to-date CRM and a short weekly pipeline review.- Set up the tools you work with every day, from offer templates to your CRM.RequirementsWhat you bring- 5 to 10 years in B2B sales, ideally around 7, with a clear record of closing- Deals of €2m to €10m and more that you personally negotiated and closed- Experience with buyers who decide in groups: users, technical teams, procurement, legal and management- You do the work yourself. You research accounts, pick up the phone and write your own offers, without a team preparing things for you.- Closing is what drives you. You chase the next step, follow up until you get an answer and don’t let deals stall.- You write down offers, decisions and customer commitments, so Operations and the founders can act on them without asking- Willingness to travel 30-50%, mostly within Germany and Europe, sometimes further- Fluent English; German is a strong plus- Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting, which some customer sites requireNice to have- Experience selling hardware or other physical products with lead times and delivery commitments- Experience with defence, public-sector or other long, regulated buying processes- You’ve worked as the first or only salesperson in a company beforeFurther InformationYou start with a solid base salary that gives you a stable foundation. On top of that comes a strong variable component tied directly to the deals you close: the more you close, the more you earn, and strong performers earn well above their base. You also participate in Hive through our VSOP, so you share in the value you help build.Über unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- **Compensation. **We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: MarketingZwingend erforderlich: Vertrieb
